papers.title: Efficient Multiscale Gaussian Process Regression using Hierarchical Clustering
papers.abstract: Standard Gaussian Process (GP) regression, a powerful machine learning tool, is computationally expensive when it is applied to large datasets, and potentially inaccurate when data points are sparsely distributed in a high-dimensional feature space. To address these challenges, a new multiscale, sparsified GP algorithm is formulated, with the goal of application to large scientific computing datasets. In this approach, the data is partitioned into clusters and the cluster centers are used to define a reduced training set, resulting in an improvement over standard GPs in terms of training and evaluation costs. Further, a hierarchical technique is used to adaptively map the local covariance representation to the underlying sparsity of the feature space, leading to improved prediction accuracy when the data distribution is highly non-uniform. A theoretical investigation of the computational complexity of the algorithm is presented. The efficacy of this method is then demonstrated on smooth and discontinuous analytical functions and on data from a direct numerical simulation of turbulent combustion.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于层次聚类的多尺度高斯过程回归方法，可扩展到生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on computational efficiency for large-scale GP regression with applications to scientific computing (turbulent combustion), but does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for design, or transfer to implant/biomechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准高斯过程回归在大数据集和高维空间中计算昂贵且精度低。
summary_zh.method: 将数据分层聚类，利用聚类中心构建稀疏训练集，并自适应处理非均匀分布。
summary_zh.result: 在光滑和不连续解析函数及湍流燃烧数据上展示了计算效率与预测精度的提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过解析函数测试和直接数值模拟数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian process regression suffers from high computational cost on large datasets and poor accuracy in high-dimensional spaces with sparse data.
summary_en.method: A multiscale sparsified GP algorithm partitions data into clusters, uses cluster centers as reduced training set, and adaptively maps local covariance to feature space sparsity via hierarchical technique.
summary_en.result: The method improves training and evaluation efficiency and prediction accuracy on both smooth and discontinuous analytical functions and turbulent combustion simulation data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on analytical functions and a direct numerical simulation of turbulent combustion.

papers.title: Active Perceptual Similarity Modeling with Auxiliary Information
papers.abstract: Learning a model of perceptual similarity from a collection of objects is a fundamental task in machine learning underlying numerous applications. A common way to learn such a model is from relative comparisons in the form of triplets: responses to queries of the form "Is object a more similar to b than it is to c?". If no consideration is made in the determination of which queries to ask, existing similarity learning methods can require a prohibitively large number of responses. In this work, we consider the problem of actively learning from triplets -finding which queries are most useful for learning. Different from previous active triplet learning approaches, we incorporate auxiliary information into our similarity model and introduce an active learning scheme to find queries that are informative for quickly learning both the relevant aspects of auxiliary data and the directly-learned similarity components. Compared to prior approaches, we show that we can learn just as effectively with much fewer queries. For evaluation, we introduce a new dataset of exhaustive triplet comparisons obtained from humans and demonstrate improved performance for different types of auxiliary information.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文关于感知相似性主动学习，与有限元代理模型或植入物设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses active triplet learning for perceptual similarity, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少相似性学习中所需的三元组查询数量。
summary_zh.method: 利用辅助信息进行主动三元组查询选择。
summary_zh.result: 比现有方法用更少查询达到同等效果。
summary_zh.validation: 在人类标注数据集上测试不同辅助信息。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of triplet queries needed for learning perceptual similarity.
summary_en.method: An active learning scheme that incorporates auxiliary information to select informative triplets.
summary_en.result: Achieves comparable learning performance with significantly fewer queries than prior methods.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on a new human-annotated dataset of exhaustive triplets with various auxiliary information types.

papers.title: Deep Kernel Learning
papers.abstract: We introduce scalable deep kernels, which combine the structural properties of deep learning architectures with the non-parametric flexibility of kernel methods. Specifically, we transform the inputs of a spectral mixture base kernel with a deep architecture, using local kernel interpolation, inducing points, and structure exploiting (Kronecker and Toeplitz) algebra for a scalable kernel representation. These closed-form kernels can be used as drop-in replacements for standard kernels, with benefits in expressive power and scalability. We jointly learn the properties of these kernels through the marginal likelihood of a Gaussian process. Inference and learning cost $O(n)$ for $n$ training points, and predictions cost $O(1)$ per test point. On a large and diverse collection of applications, including a dataset with 2 million examples, we show improved performance over scalable Gaussian processes with flexible kernel learning models, and stand-alone deep architectures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移用于构建高效代理模型，但尚未应用于生物力学或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not apply to implant/biomechanics design, does not handle constraints, no FEA-based benchmark, no physical simulation validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升核方法的表达力与可扩展性，适应大规模数据
summary_zh.method: 将深度架构与谱混合基核结合，利用局部核插值和结构代数加速
summary_zh.result: 在200万样本数据上取得更优性能，训练复杂度O(n)且预测O(1)
summary_zh.validation: 在多个大规模分类与回归数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the expressiveness and scalability of kernel methods for large-scale data.
summary_en.method: Combines deep architectures with a spectral mixture base kernel using local kernel interpolation, inducing points, and Kronecker/Toeplitz algebra for efficient computation.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior performance on a dataset with 2 million examples, with O(n) training and O(1) per-test-point cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a diverse collection of large-scale classification and regression datasets.
